_schema.backs: Table B.6-1 (failure-mode distribution across F-structure interventions at ~12% depth) and the qualitative F-mix / F-attenuate rates in Section 5.2
_schema.design: 10 instruction-tuned models x 84 Diverse prompts x 2 conditions
_schema.important: These labels are produced by a DETERMINISTIC RULE-BASED SCRIPT, not by a human or a language model. That is the opposite of all_classifications_v4.json and all_classifications_v5_fdynamic_audit.json, which are supervised judgments. Re-running classify_f_structure.py on the shipped continuation files regenerates this file exactly. The `rule` field records which branch of the classifier fired.

fields.label: the assigned outcome category
fields.rule: the classifier branch and its evidence (topic overlap, shared keywords, script change, degeneracy reason)
fields.identical: true when the intervened continuation is byte-identical to the baseline; these bypass the classifier
fields.linguistic_regime: the Diverse prompt set's own category label for the prompt, used by the classifier's specialized-category branch
